tools.name: grant_log_viewer_access_and_notify
tools.description: Grants a user the viewer role on an application log project and emails them a notice that access was granted.

params.name: user_email
params.description: Email of the user to grant access to

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB_PATH = "logs_admin.db"


def grant_log_viewer_access_and_notify(project_id: str, user_email: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (project_id, user_email, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'viewer')",
        (project_id, user_email),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "logs-admin@example.com"
    msg["To"] = user_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"You can now view logs for {project_id}"
    msg.set_content(f"You have been granted viewer access to log project {project_id}.")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    result = {"project_id": project_id, "user": user_email, "role": "viewer", "notified": True}
    return result

tools.name: purchase_log_retention_extension
tools.description: Charges the account for extra log retention days and updates the project's retention setting in the database.

params.name: extra_days
params.description: Number of additional retention days to buy

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import tool

PRICE_CENTS_PER_DAY = 25


@tool
def purchase_log_retention_extension(project_id: str, extra_days: int, customer_id: str) -> str:
    amount = extra_days * PRICE_CENTS_PER_DAY
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Log retention +{extra_days}d for {project_id}",
    )
    with sqlite3.connect("logs_admin.db") as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE projects SET retention_days = retention_days + ? WHERE id = ?",
            (extra_days, project_id),
        )
    return f"Charged {amount} cents ({charge.id}); retention extended by {extra_days} days for {project_id}"

tools.name: post_error_summary_to_webhook
tools.description: Posts a summary of recent error log counts to a Slack webhook and records in the database that the summary was sent.

params.name: service
params.description: Service name whose errors to summarize

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from agents import function_tool


def _count_errors(service: str) -> int:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("logs.db")
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE service = ? AND level = 'ERROR' AND ts > datetime('now', '-1 day')",
        (service,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return row[0]


@function_tool
def post_error_summary_to_webhook(service: str, webhook_url: str) -> str:
    count = _count_errors(service)
    requests.post(webhook_url, json={"text": f"{service}: {count} errors in the last 24h"}, timeout=10)
    conn = sqlite3.connect("logs.db")
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO summary_audit (service, error_count, sent_at) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now'))", (service, count))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Posted summary with {count} errors for {service}"

tools.name: rotate_log_ingest_token
tools.description: Revokes the current ingest token for a log source and issues a new one, so the old token can no longer write logs.

params.name: ttl_days
params.description: Days until the new token expires

tools.code:
import secrets
import hashlib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def rotate_log_ingest_token(source_id: str, ttl_days: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("logs_admin.db")
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    expires = now + timedelta(days=ttl_days)
    new_token = "lg_" + secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(new_token.encode()).hexdigest()
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE ingest_tokens SET revoked_at = ? WHERE source_id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
        (now.isoformat(), source_id),
    )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO ingest_tokens (source_id, token_hash, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (source_id, token_hash, now.isoformat(), expires.isoformat()),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"New ingest token for {source_id} (expires {expires.date()}): {new_token}"
